name: Pascal
source:
Camille’s younger cousin, who often argues with them about how much time they spend shut away from society. He’s abrasive and unsympathetic, but he may be the only person around with Camille’s better interests at heart. 

[From [url=https://blank-house.itch.io/that-which-surrounds]itch.io[/url]]
